caption: The drawing features a vertical rectangular area with a beige or light brown background. At the top, there is a horizontal row of five black heart shapes, with clusters of small black dots positioned beneath and between them. Below this, the middle section displays two stylized botanical forms: on the left, a tall vertical stem with alternating black and white elongated leaves, and on the right, a branching plant composed of many short stems, each with black and white leaves. The lower portion of the drawing contains two rows of decorative patterns: the upper row has five evenly spaced black heart shapes with scattered small black dots around them, below which is a narrow band consisting of alternating short black and reddish-brown rectangles. The bottom section consists of a wavy diagonal stripe pattern with alternating black and reddish-brown stripes, set against a background filled with small black and reddish-brown dots, bordered by thin black horizontal lines at the top and bottom. The overall arrangement appears symmetrical and organized, with a limited color palette of beige, black, white, and reddish-brown.
title: Wall Decoration
